beaches.name: Tou Papa to Choma
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across the town beach below Skyros Town. A naturist directory calls it the island's nudist beach with visitor reports from 2000 to 2005; an undated directory entry repeats the description, and the municipal beach list does not mention nudism.

beaches.name: Agios Petros
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported across the beach, with clothed visitors at one side. A naturist directory carries a report from August 2015 of a group bathing nude and free camping; no newer report is documented.
